title: Synergistically enhancing the selective adsorption for crystal planes to regulate the (002)-texture preferred Zn deposition via supramolecular host–guest units
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4859-4871
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00763A, Paper
Lequan Wang, Yizhen Shao, Zhongheng Fu, Xianfu Zhang, Junming Kang, Xingxiu Yang, Zhimin Zhai, Ying Ge, Long Zhang, Yanglong Hou, Hongbin Lu
Supramolecular host–guest units synergistically enhance the selectivity and adsorption ability for Zn crystal planes, facilitating homogeneous Zn(002) deposition at high current densities and areal capacities.
